notes:
Summary: Solaris is a mid-market CCaaS provider focusing on retail & telco customers. Primary pain: recurring seasonal traffic spikes (Black Friday, product launches) that cause queue backpressure and degraded agent-assist performance. They want predictable inference latency under bursts and a path to on-prem/VPC for regulated telco customers.

Key quotes / snippets:
- "We need agent assist to remain sub-200ms P95 during peak spikes or agents will abandon the UI." — Head of Platform
- "If we can't guarantee throughput during promotions, we lose customers." — VP Customer Ops

POC ask: 2-week stress PoC that simulates 3x baseline peak and a multi-hour storm scenario; validate autoscaling, caching, and fallback to smaller quantized models. Must show: sustained 400 rps (chat requests) with ability to burst to 1200 rps for 10 minutes; P95 latency target <200ms for model responses; integration with Genesys CTI for tool-calls.

Security & compliance: SAML SSO required; SOC2 report mandatory; KMS integration for key rotation; 30-day audit log retention and EU data residency for specific retail customers.

Commercial: evaluating Dedicated vs Private; cost sensitivity around token pricing during high-volume weekends. Estimated ARR bucket anchored ~50k-250k. Procurement lead expects decision after PoC and security signoff.

Misc short notes: shorthand follow-ups, some overlap with drive deck v2. Sent security questionnaire 2026-02-28 — awaiting responses from infra. SE working on stress harness. CSM looped for onboarding timeline.
